title: The warehouse
content: Has anyone else been inside the warehouse that’s around this mall world? I have dreamt a few times about being inside the warehouse, I have never been outside of the building in my dreams. I just found out about this mall world thing and I have a few dreams i have had about being inside and around the mall and movie theatre, but the most vivid I have right now is being inside the warehouse. I’m always trying to find a way out and I’m always being chased or looked for by someone. I usually never find a way out but I find many stair cases and small hallways and many doors to go through. Never a door to go outside though. Sometimes the stairs just go from hallway to hallway without any doors to break them up if that makes any sense. Sometimes there’s twists and turns that are weird. I think there was one dream I had where I was trying to find a way out and someone was chasing me, I may have found a way out but the second I opened the door and thought I saw sunlight I woke up. But like I said I have never been outside or have really gotten out of the building and if I’ve come close I wake up. Anyone else?
